facts.fact: BoFiNet's Integrated Report 2025 (financial year to 31 March 2025) states Botswana has 3 international submarine cable systems, EASSy, WACS and Equiano, and that BoFiNet manages EASSy and WACS international cable access; no landing stations or neighbours are named.
